observation.command: pg_ctlcluster 15 main start && su - postgres -c "psql -c \"CREATE USER initxplanbox PASSWORD 'initxplanbox';\" -c \"CREATE USER xplanbox PASSWORD 'xplanbox';\" -c \"CREATE DATABASE xplanbox OWNER initxplanbox;\"" && su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;'" && su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c 'SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension;'"
